_comment: Copy to local_ci_hosts.json (gitignored) and edit. 'runners' maps a GitHub runs-on label to a host; labels left out are reported as SKIPPED. Host 'env' values are shell expressions expanded on the host. 'step_overrides' replace (string) or skip (null) workflow steps by name on that host only; the summary lists every override.

step_overrides.build-macos/Build:
cd source
cmake -B build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DSTAR_BUILD_TESTS=ON -DOpenMP_ROOT=$HOME/opt/libomp
cmake --build build
